in_hebrew.name: Urson
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Strong, Son of a bear
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Urson הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old High German 'ursa' meaning bear and 'son', the name Urson can be translated as 'strong, son of a bear'. In medieval Europe, bears were considered sacred animals, and their cubs were believed to possess great strength and courage. This name carries a powerful and noble connotation, making it an excellent choice for a baby boy.
